name: Power-law CFG
plain: A cfg that changes with the size of the guidance difference at each step. For α above 0 it is weaker when positive and negative agree and stronger when they differ; α below 0 reverses that. The space for measuring the norm is selectable.
math:
d = x̂_c − x̂_u, scaled by space:
 score: flow (1−σ)/(σ²+1); else 1/(σ²+1)
 eps/v/flow: 1/(σ+1)
 x0: unchanged
φ = max(s·(‖d‖₂+1e-6)^α, 1), norm over non-batch dims
x̂ = x̂_u + φ·(x̂_c−x̂_u)

props.extra_model_calls: 0 (uncond forced at cfg 1 only when α≈0 per code)

label: from code
surprise: The description says cfg 1 skip is disabled, but the code sets the flag true only when α≈0, which is the case that needs it least.
